title: REMOTE SENSING: PRINCIPLES AND APPLICATIONS
description: Focuses on fundamentals of satellite remote sensing and image analysis. Topics include physical principles of remote sensing from the ultraviolet to the microwave, sensors and sensor technology, and environmental applications of remote sensing through image analysis.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: GEOG 201, 360, FE 257 or CE 202.
A minimum grade of C- is required in GEOG 201, GEOG 360, FE 257 and CE 202.
recommendations: Basic skills/understanding in trigonometry, algebra, and physics
meeting_html: R 4pm-5:50pm in WLKN 210 - Wilkinson Hall 210 (9/23 to 12/4)
